import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    G = np.tanh(params[0]*t)
    return (params[1]*G + params[2]*P + params[3]*P**2 + params[4]*P**3 + params[5]*P*t
            + params[6]*P*G + params[7]*P**2*G + params[8]*P**3*G + params[9]*P**2*t)
